summary.goal: Visualize plan execution flow based on dependencies and workflow state, not calendar time
summary.context: In agent-driven planning, time is not the primary constraint - dependencies and human gates are. Plans complete when agents finish and humans approve, not on calendar schedules. Pipeline view shows execution sequence (what can run now, what's waiting) and workflow state (drafting, gate, running, done).
in_scope: Board view showing workflow state columns

notes.rationale: Traditional roadmaps assume time-based scheduling. Agent-driven planning has unpredictable durations - work completes when agents finish, not on calendar dates. The real constraints are dependencies (what blocks what) and human gates (approval checkpoints). Pipeline view surfaces these constraints instead of pretending we know timing.
notes.implementation_summary: All 18 planned implementation steps completed. Pipeline view fully functional with Sequence and Board view modes, initiative filtering, and proper styling.

divergences.title: Status filter dropdown
divergences.description: Status filter dropdown (All/Active/Blocked/Complete) was NOT implemented in toolbar
divergences.reasoning: The implementation uses wave-based organization (NOW/Wave2/Wave3/DONE) and status-based grouping (Drafting/Gate/Approved/Running/Complete) as primary organizational methods. Additional filtering on top of view mode selection adds UI complexity without clear UX benefit. The two view modes already provide orthogonal filtering perspectives.
divergences.impact: MINOR - Users can switch view modes instead. This is deferred to v2 as a potential enhancement.

divergences.title: Dependency arrows
divergences.description: Dependency arrows connecting plans in SequenceView exist as a component (DependencyArrow.tsx) but are NOT integrated into SequenceView
divergences.reasoning: DependencyArrow component was created (p008) and tested, but integration into SequenceView requires accurate card position measurement and SVG overlay coordination. This adds performance complexity for visual-only feedback. The wave structure itself provides dependency visualization (Wave 2 depends on NOW, etc.).
divergences.impact: MINOR - Dependency structure is visible through wave layout. SVG arrows are a nice-to-have that could be added incrementally without breaking changes.
